dsh-any-background 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。自定义外观插件：换背景图（可调大小和位置）、用色轮自定义主题色，主界面和设置界面的透明度都能单独调。

dsh-any-background is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. A DeepSeek Harness appearance plugin that lets you fully customize the Web UI with a custom theme color, background wallpaper, and fine-grained opacity controls.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-69b93336c97ac8c3ebba.html
